title: DNS Service Binding RFC 9461 Publication Plan Architecture
purpose: Define the bounded RFC 9461 operator publication-record generation boundary for DNS service bindings.
design_summary: `DnsServiceBindingPublicationPlan` turns validated scalar `DnsServiceBindingRecord` values into deterministic presentation-format publication records. It derives the DNS SVCB owner name through RFC 9461 Port Prefix Naming, normalizes ServiceMode TargetName values, renders `alpn`, `port`, `dohpath`, and HTTPS SvcParams in stable order, and includes an equivalent HTTPS record only when operator guidance recommends one and the binding advertises an HTTP ALPN. Fast-resolution guidance is surfaced as `AvoidsAliasMode`; the planner emits ServiceMode records only.
data_and_state_considerations: The planner is a pure value renderer. It does not contact DNS providers, mutate zone files, sign DNSSEC records, install host resolver configuration, or establish encrypted DNS sessions.
edge_cases_and_constraints: TargetName values must normalize as DNS names accepted by the local SVCB resolution helpers.
Equivalent HTTPS records are omitted when no HTTP ALPN is present even if guidance recommends publication.
Quoted SvcParam values escape quotes and backslashes for deterministic presentation output.
risks: The planner does not validate provider-specific DNS master-file dialects.
The planner does not publish or verify records in an authoritative DNS service.
The planner does not perform DNSSEC signing or DS/DNSKEY management.

supplemental_sections.heading: Implementation Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: Keeping publication planning as deterministic scalar output makes the guidance auditable without coupling the DNS package to provider credentials, DNSSEC key material, or external control planes.
